Activate Magic Item.name: Activate Magic Item
Activate Magic Item.description: The character activates a magic item. If the magic item replicates an effect, it replicates the action requirements of the effect. Otherwise, it is a core action.

Coup de Grace.name: Coup de Grace
Coup de Grace.description: The character kills an unconscious target.

Draw Item.name: Draw Item
Draw Item.description: The character draws a handheld item of their choice, typically a weapon. If the item weighs more than 10 kilograms, the action cost will increase, as determined by the GM.

Drop.name: Drop
Drop.description: The character drops the equipment in their hands — shield, weapon, item, or any combination of these.

Drop Spell.name: Drop Spell
Drop Spell.description: The character immediately ends a focus or continuous spell.

Hold Action.name: Hold Action
Hold Action.description: The character holds their action, consuming their reaction in the process — waiting for a specified cue.

Impale.name: Impale
Impale.description: For every 15’ the character moves, they add a d6 of damage — adding this damage to the weapon to the weapon’s base damage upon a successful hit. The character must utilize their entire movement action in a single direction to impale a target. The maximum damage that they can inflict with this action is 12d6.

Mount.name: Mount
Mount.description: The character utilizes their swift action to mount or dismount a willing target under the character’s command.

Move.name: Move
Move.description: The character uses up their movement action, going up to a maximum of their movement speed.

Re-Attempt.name: Re-Attempt
Re-Attempt.description: Characters can typically re-attempt a resistance check. Most re-attempts require a swift action unless otherwise stated.

Remove.name: Remove
Remove.description: The character removes all instances of Suffering.

Strike.name: Strike
Strike.description: The character makes an attack roll, inflicting the weapon’s damage on hit.

Weapon Attack.name: Weapon Attack
Weapon Attack.description: When using the Weapon Attack ability, the character gains the ability to make a single strike with a weapon they are using, and gain Martial Points (MP) equal to their ranks in the weapon’s combat style.

Stand.name: Stand
Stand.description: The character uses up ½ of their movement to stand up from prone.

Maintain Focus.name: Maintain Focus
Maintain Focus.description: The character maintains a focus ability. A character can only ever maintain focus on a single ability at once.

Take Cover.name: Take Cover
Take Cover.description: The character takes cover in a location, gaining 2 bonus DVs. They only retain the beneits of cover as long as the cover would reasonably defend them against attack rolls. The character loses the beneits of cover as soon as they move from cover, or they leave the cover to cast a spell, make an attack roll, etc. Exceptionally protective cover grants 4 bonus DVs and blocks line of sight to the target.

Throw.name: Throw
Throw.description: The character launches an item in their hand by doing a might check. The character launches the item a number of feet equal to twice the might check.
